proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: After the February 2021 freeze we wanted a plan for the next outage. They sized a portable generator with us and installed the inlet and interlock. Fridge, furnace fan and lights all run on it.
reviews.name: Marisol V.

reviews.text: Our 1968 ranch has aluminum wiring. They walked every room, put rated connectors on each outlet and switch, and left a sheet listing what they found in every box.
reviews.name: Glenn H.

reviews.text: The panel door used to say kitchen with a question mark on half the breakers. Now every circuit is typed, numbered and matches the room. Small thing, but the inspector noticed it right away.
reviews.name: Ana P.

reviews.text: The breaker for the back bedroom tripped every evening. They found a space heater and a window unit sharing one old circuit and split them onto two. No more trips.
reviews.name: Derek S.

reviews.text: The standby generator took about three weeks from quote to running, mostly waiting on the gas meter upgrade. Once it was in, the test run and the walkthrough were thorough.
reviews.name: Kathy W.

reviews.text: The hot tub needed a disconnect and GFCI before the city would sign off. They handled the permit, tied in everything, and passed inspection the first time.
reviews.name: Ray F.

proof.guarantee: Our labor is covered for two years; if a connection we made fails, we come back and fix it.
